mapper.select:
select count(*) from intro_post i left join member m on i.member_id = m.member_id left join univ_department ud on m.dept_id = ud.dept_id
AND i.match_scope = '교내' AND ud.univ_name = #{userUnivName} AND m.approved = 1
AND i.match_scope = '전국'
AND i.kind = #{kind}
AND (
i.category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{cat}, '%')
)
AND (i.category != '학과' OR m.dept_id = #{userDeptId})
AND (i.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

select i.*, m.name as member_name, m.major as member_major, m.grade as member_grade, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE post_id = i.post_id) AS comment_count from intro_post i left join member m on i.member_id = m.member_id left join univ_department ud on m.dept_id = ud.dept_id
AND i.match_scope = '교내' AND ud.univ_name = #{userUnivName} AND m.approved != 0
AND i.match_scope = '전국'
AND i.kind = #{kind}
AND (
i.category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{cat}, '%')
)
AND (i.category != '학과' OR m.dept_id = #{userDeptId})
AND (i.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR i.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by i.view_count desc, i.created_at desc
order by i.favorite_count desc, i.created_at desc
order by i.created_at desc
limit #{amount} offset #{offset}
select i.*, m.name as member_name, m.major as member_major, m.grade as member_grade from intro_post i left join member m on i.member_id = m.member_id where i.post_id = #{postId}
mapper.update: update intro_post set title = #{title}, kind = #{kind}, category = #{category}, available_time = #{availableTime}, match_scope = #{matchScope}, content = #{content}, tags = #{tags}, field = #{field} where post_id = #{postId}
mapper.select: select p.project_id as projectId, p.title as title, p.status as status, p.capacity as capacity, p.match_scope as matchScope, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM participation WHERE project_id = p.project_id AND join_status = 'JOINED') AS currentNum FROM project p WHERE p.owner_id = #{memberId}
mapper.delete: delete from favorite_post where member_id = #{memberId} and post_id = #{postId}
mapper.select: select p.* from intro_post p inner join favorite_post f on p.post_id = f.post_id where f.member_id = #{memberId} order by p.post_id desc
